data.text: Resources include hardware, software, manpower, and supporting infrastructure. Optimization is needed because XR and VR are resource hungry, and the goal is to minimize requirements while maximizing the VR experience. VR resource optimization generally focuses on client-side hardware because it is the most straightforward way to provide a good experience with affordable resources.
points: Resources include hardware, software, manpower, and supporting infrastructure.
Optimization is needed because XR and VR are resource hungry and the goal is to minimize requirements while maximizing the VR experience.
VR resource optimization generally focuses on client-side hardware because it is the most straightforward way to provide a good experience with affordable resources.

data.text: Immersive VR requires high-end hardware to support complex rendering requirements. Since computers use binary representations while humans perceive realistic images, the fundamental problem of computer graphics is representing and synthesizing objects for human perception. This core problem involves representation, synthesis, interaction, and animation.
points: Immersive VR requires high-end hardware to support complex rendering requirements.
Computers use binary representations, but humans perceive realistic images.
The fundamental problem of computer graphics is representing and synthesizing objects for human perception.
This core problem involves representation, synthesis, interaction, and animation.

data.text: A generic graphics system uses a host computer to communicate with a display controller, which handles image generation so the CPU's time is not consumed by rendering. The display controller stores these digital images in video memory. Finally, the video controller converts the stored data into voltages to activate the pixels on the screen.
points: A generic graphics system consists of a host computer, a display controller, video memory, and a video controller.
The CPU communicates with the display controller to send commands and receive interaction data.
The display controller handles image generation so that the CPU's time is not consumed by rendering.
The display controller sends the digital image representation to be stored in video memory.
The video controller converts the data from video memory into voltages to activate the pixels on the screen.

data.text: Graphic devices are broadly of two types: vector scan and raster scan. Vector scan devices render images by exciting only the pixels that represent geometric primitives, but they are costly and typically used in specialized settings because they require high precision. Raster scan devices activate all pixels in sequence and require less precision, making them much cheaper and the typical choice for commercial products.
points: Graphic devices are broadly of two types: vector scan and raster scan.
Vector scan devices render images by exciting only the selected pixels that represent geometric primitives.
Vector scan devices are costly and typically used in specialized settings because they require high precision.
Raster scan devices activate all pixels in sequence, which is called scanning.
Raster scan devices are much cheaper and typically comprise commercial products because they require less precision.

data.text: The frame buffer stores intensity values for all pixels, and its size is equal to the screen resolution. Pixels must be periodically refreshed to prevent fading and distortion caused by their order of excitation, with higher refresh rates being preferable in VR because the screen is much closer to the eyes. Color is perceived when the red, green, and blue light from the pixel elements is mixed in the eye.
points: The frame buffer stores intensity values for all pixels, and its size is equal to the screen resolution.
Pixels must be periodically refreshed to prevent fading and distortion caused by their order of excitation.
A higher refresh rate is preferable in VR because the screen is much closer to the eyes.

data.text: The three-dimensional (3D) computer graphics pipeline is a stage-wise process of computation. It starts from object representation and ends with rendering on the pixel grid.
points: The 3D graphics pipeline is a stage-wise process of computation.
It starts with object representation and ends with rendering on the pixel grid.
